filed: 2026-11-16, before any run; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)
question: Do the share and the cheap readings still separate the pairs when the two sides are matched in update size?
descriptive: Sides are named as each pair was built (67M) or as side A and side B (Qwen). No reading is called reuse or new, and no score joins the readings.

matching.size: ||dW|| / ||W0|| over every matrix of the update (67M: the 24 matrices; Qwen: all 196, the library's dw_norm over the shared W0, P3.7's size)
matching.factor: per pair cell, c = mean size of the smaller side / mean size of the larger side (seeds as saved); every state of the larger side is multiplied by c (one scalar for all matrices); the smaller side is not read again
matching.why_one_factor_per_cell: side means match exactly and each side keeps its own seed spread, which the 67M rule reads (implementation choice, compare-lead 2026-11-16)

expected_c_from_saved_sizes.source: 67M: experiments/method_table/results/final.json size cells (ratio of side means; run.py recomputes from the files); Qwen: experiments/qwen_library_readings/results/<pair>/stage2.json .states[].size
expected_c_from_saved_sizes.67M_larger_side: new on every pair but open_pair_c3 and open_pair_c3_copy (reuse); e54_own's saved size cell counts 5 new states where the share reads 2 (cipher_own), so its c is recomputed
expected_c_from_saved_sizes.Qwen_larger_side: cipher, invented at both saves; gold_shuf at last, gold at 5x

sources.share_tol: E136's reproduce_tol and E147's reader_share_tol (experiments/share_untrained/results/predictions.json, experiments/refit_96key/results/predictions.json); every saved reproduction through these readers on an L40 read a difference of exactly 0 (experiments/holes_fill/results/stage0.json reproduce, experiments/refit_96key/results/stage0.json checks 'a ...'); used for share and steering
sources.neuron_tol: E143's neuron_tol and E147's reader_neuron_tol; k_half_fill's reproduce_tol for r_half (experiments/k_half_fill/results/predictions.json); all measured 0 on the L40; k_half itself must be equal
sources.c_agree_rel: the E136 and E98 loaders read the same saved files where both read a state; float64 sums
sources.erank_rel: one scalar leaves every singular-value share and every ||dW_m||^2 weight unchanged; fp32 rounding of c x dW moves it by ~1e-8
sources.projected_limit_min: E143 read ~56 states in 9.6 min and E172 37 carrying sets in about 5 min on an L40 (holes_fill stage1 projected_minutes, cluster/k_half_fill.sbatch); 40 states here through four readers, ~15 min expected, 3x margin

controls.a: c from E136's files equals c from E98's files (k_half's) within c_agree_rel on every pair; a miss stops
controls.b: c = 1 reproduces the saved reading: share and holes_fill neuron (k64, kmatched) and steering (pooled, per key) on e54/cipher_s0 and e58/cipher_s0; E135 steering on e62/lookup_s0; k_half (equal) and r_half on cipher_s0 and e58/cipher_s0. Expected difference 0 on an L40; a miss stops
controls.c: the random floor: a Gaussian at the larger side's first state's per-matrix norms times c; its mean log-odds gain on that side's rows. Expected |gain| well under the gain floor (1 log-odds), so every gain share of a random change is undefined and the 67M floor of a gap is the seed ranges. Reported, not a stop (no measured bar)
controls.per_state: erank(c dW) = erank(dW) within erank_rel; E98's identity, telescope and grid-end checks; a miss stops

qwen.decomposition: p-015e0710 (the frozen-neuron one) only: on p-9707d6ff every update and random change reads within about 1% of the ceiling (2026-11-16 gate page), so it has no room to separate

sources.share_tol: a tenth of the seed spread P3.9 adds to every band (0.00196, experiments/qwen_library_share/results/p-015e0710/predictions.json description.spread); cross-card rounding with fp32 matmuls is expected near 1e-6 but was never measured on the same state
sources.steer_tol: the smallest within-side seed range of steering at one save among the larger sides (cipher at 5x, 0.8456 to 0.8477, experiments/qwen_library_readings/results/copy_cipher/stage2.json)
sources.overlap_tol: a tenth of the smallest P3.7 overlap floor band (0.0302, experiments/qwen_library_readings/results/gold/stage1.json band.overlap)

controls.share stage 0: W0 as the fine-tune on 16 rows of each row set and the do-nothing state through the split path (P3.9's controls, unchanged); c = 1 on seed 0's late larger-side state against P3.9's saved share (run2/<key>.json regating) within share_tol; then per save the random floor: P3.9's Gaussian draw at the scaled seed-0 state's per-matrix norms, KL-matched on 16 rows, read; must be 'scored' (P3.9's stop). A miss stops
controls.readings stage 2: c = 1 on seed 0's late larger-side state against P3.7's saved steer and overlap (within steer_tol, overlap_tol) and erank (erank_rel). A miss stops
controls.per_state: erank of the scaled state equals P3.7's saved erank of the same state within erank_rel

rules.67M_call: the scorecard's rule, unchanged (experiments/method_table/plot_final.py score): with two or more values a side, 'apart' iff the seed ranges do not overlap, else 'no call'; one value on a side 'one value a side'. Gap: shares, reuse mean minus new mean; neurons for half the gain, log10(new mean / reuse mean). A state whose k_half is None is left out of its side, as the scorecard leaves it out
rules.qwen_share_call: P3.9's rule, unchanged (qwen_library_share run.cell): per seed gap A - B; band = |random gap| + 0.00196; 'beyond band' if every |gap| > band with one sign, 'inside band' if |mean gap| <= band, 'mixed' else, 'unreadable' if under 3 gaps or any None. The matched band's random gap: this run's floor (larger side, scaled) against P3.9's run-1 record of the smaller side (seed 0, KL-matched), signed A - B
rules.qwen_cheap_call: P3.7's rule, unchanged (qwen_library_readings rules.floored) against P3.7's floor bands (stage1.json band): those random changes span the library's smallest to largest norm, which brackets every matched size, so the bands stand. Steering's band is None on copy_cipher and facts: 'unreadable' there, before and after
rules.outcome: per reading and pair cell, comparing the unscaled call with the matched one: 'kept' (separated both times, same sign of mean gap), 'flipped' (both, opposite sign), 'lost' (separated unscaled, not matched), 'gained' (matched only), 'neither', 'unreadable' (either call unreadable or one value a side). Separated means 'apart', 'beyond band' or 'beyond floor'
rules.not_read: the prior does not depend on the update; effective rank is unchanged by one scalar (checked per state, not drawn); size is matched by construction (gap 0)

rivals.size_only: the readings track only update size: every cell separated unscaled reads 'lost' once matched
rivals.more_than_size: a reading carries more than size: it reads 'kept' on the cells it separated unscaled

expected.control: c = 1: difference 0 on the 67M (L40), within the tolerances on Qwen; erank unchanged on every state
expected.do_nothing: a do-nothing update on both sides gives equal values, overlapping ranges and gap 0: 'no call' / 'inside', so the outcome is 'lost' or 'neither' and it can never read 'kept' (checked by hand against both rules 2026-11-16; cpu-run was down)
expected.three_matched_67M_pairs: e54_matched, open_pair_c3, open_pair_c3_copy have c of 0.987 to 0.998: every reading's call there is expected unchanged (kept or neither as unscaled)
expected.67M_share: kept on 9 of 9 built pairs (the share separates the three already size-matched pairs by 0.52 to 0.62, final.json); a 'lost' on any pair is a reversal to flag
expected.67M_steering_neuron_top_k_half: no direction filed: this is what the run measures. Unscaled, steering separates 7 of 9, the top neurons 9 of 9, neurons for half the gain 6 of 9 (final.json)
expected.qwen_share: in every pair cell the side with the smaller weight change reads the higher share (gate page), so the matched gap is expected closer to 0 than the unscaled one: |mean matched gap| < |mean unscaled gap| in at least 5 of 6 cells; the three cells beyond band unscaled (facts late, gold late, gold matched) expected 'lost' if the size_only rival holds
expected.qwen_overlap: every unscaled overlap gap beyond floor came with side A the smaller change; expected |mean matched gap| < |mean unscaled gap| in every cell beyond floor unscaled (copy_cipher both saves, facts 5x, gold late)
expected.qwen_steer: copy_cipher and facts unreadable before and after (no floor); gold inside floor before and after

P1.rule: count of the nine built pairs with outcome 'kept'

P2.rule: count of the six pair cells with |mean matched gap| < |mean unscaled gap|

P3.rule: count of the four cells beyond floor unscaled whose |mean matched gap| < |mean unscaled gap|

edge_cases.checked: by hand against the code paths named in rules (cpu-run down 2026-11-16, so not run); to be run on CPU through plot.py's outcome() before the job if cpu-run returns
edge_cases.do-nothing both sides: values equal: ranges overlap -> 'no call'; Qwen gaps 0 -> 'inside band'/'inside floor'; outcome never 'kept'
edge_cases.c = 1 (a pair already matched): matched cell equals unscaled cell; outcome 'kept' or 'neither' as unscaled
edge_cases.tie at the range edge: min of one side equal to max of the other: not 'apart' (strict inequalities in plot_final.score)
edge_cases.k_half None on a state: left out of its side; under two values -> 'one value a side' -> outcome 'unreadable'
edge_cases.nan share (gain under the floor): left out of its side as the scorecard does; plot.py value() drops it
edge_cases.mean gap exactly 0: outcome compares signs by g0 x g1 > 0: a 0 reads 'flipped' only if both cells separated, which a 0 mean cannot be under either rule
